Not quite. The policy gives late Express parcels a 100% credit of the shipping fee, not 150%.

NW1001 was an Express shipment promised by 2026-11-03 and delivered on 2026-11-05. That makes it late, so it qualifies for the 100% credit (P-2).

- The credit goes to your account within 7 days. It is never paid out in cash.
- It doesn't apply if the delay was caused by severe weather or by an incorrect address. Nothing in your shipment data points to either.

I can't see the shipping fee amount or the credit status in your data, so I can't confirm the exact figure.
